LESSON: VOLUME OF SOLIDS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: MEASUREMENTS
Topic 3.2: Volume of Solids
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Volume of Solids, part of MEASUREMENTS in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we determine the volume of different solids?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Volume of Solids together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and problem solving: The learner explores the link between different events as they identify and work out the

volume of a frustum from a pyramid.

Values:
● Responsibility: The learner enriches determination as they take care of the models of pyramids, cones, and spheres.

● Patriotism: The learner enhances citizenship as they collect objects from the environment to determine and discuss

models/objects for different volumes of solids.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

28

● Environmental education: The learner appreciates the gift of nature as they take care of the environment while collecting

the containers and objects.

● Safety and security: The learner collects containers and objects cautiously.

Link to other subjects:

Creative Arts and Sports: The learner makes models of pyramids, cones/funnels and spheres/balls from available materials.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Different containers and objects e.g. prisms, pyramids, cones, funnels and balls, Digital devices with assistive technology such

as screen readers, screen magnifiers and adapted keyboard, Print and Braille Course Book.
